title: Why I’m protesting against the Palantir contract: a mother’s perspective on raising her son in Poland
lede: Poland is not the first European country Palantir has approached, but other allied nations have already drawn the line. In Switzerland, the Swiss armed forces rejected Palantir’s offers nine times. The military’s conclusion was that it was technically impossible to guarantee that sensitive national data would not reach American intelligence services.

title: Listen: Why is the EU introducing a new €2 charge on parcels?
lede: From this Sunday, the EU is imposing a new €2 charge on parcels coming from outside the bloc. It comes on top of the €3 charge on small parcels announced in June.
